# Dušan Stanić

> Hiring-focused profile for Dušan Stanić, a Staff Software Engineer focused on infrastructure software, multi-cloud delivery, Kubernetes, and platform reliability.

Dušan builds production systems in Go and Python across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Nutanix AHV, and Kubernetes. His work includes Blaze, a single delivery interface orchestrating releases for 12 services; a zero-downtime migration of five services; protected US and EU production workflows; and technical guidance for 2–4 engineers. He is open to Staff Platform and Infrastructure roles.

Location: Belgrade, Serbia.

## Selected projects

- [Cyphon Filter](https://drobilica.com/cyphonfilter/): In-browser cryptography toolbox with privacy-conscious defaults.
- [Merge PDF](https://drobilica.com/merge-pdf/): Client-side PDF merging with no uploads.
- [PreventSleep](https://preventsleep.com/): Browser utility using the Wake Lock API to keep a screen awake.
